name: Crossway LE Line 12M
operators: Arriva Mobility Solutions (IDS BK regional lines)

sources.title: Iveco Crossway LE 12M – vehicle type description

notes: 80 vehicles (2021-2022) for regional lines of the Bratislava Region integrated transport system. FPT Tector 7 Euro 6d/6e diesel 235 kW, ZF 6-speed manual. Maximum speed 100 km/h with speed limiter, as stated by the source. Height 3,205 mm with air conditioning (3,140 mm without). Floor 320 mm (door 1), 330 mm (door 2); raised floor in the rear. Wheelbase 6,030 mm. Standing 43 for 2021 vehicles (42 for 2022, total 87). Capacity excludes the driver. imhd.sk: low-entry version presented 2007; over 60,000 Crossway built by 2023. A suburban low-entry bus rather than a touring coach. Livery not described.
